FULL TEXT:
Government of Jammu and Kashmir
OFFICE OF Tim DRPUn1 COMMISSIONER BANDIPORA
Join MISSION - Build the Future of Entrepreneurship in J&K
District Administration Bandipora invites applications for empanelment for Motivators under
Mission YUVA.
Retired Government Officials, NGO-workers, Pashu Sakhis, Bank Sakhis, Krishi Udyam's of KKG's
other Community Resource Persons and local community members are encouraged to apply.
Remuneration Structure for Motivators
Fixed Pay ~2,000/month
(Allowance to cover local travel and communication)
Variable Pay (Performance On the basis of number of sanctioned loan application
Incentive)
No. of Posts: 11
Eligibility
(up to a maximum of ~3,000/month)
1. 21 years and above on the date of notification.
2. Minimum 10th class pass qualification.
3. Domicile of Jammu & Kashmir.
Empaneled Motivators shall be assigned a minimum of five Panchayats/Municipal Wards in the
following Blocks/Municipal Committees: Block Gurez, Tu/ail, Ganastan, Naidkhai, Sumbal and
Municipal Committee Bandipora, Sumbal and Hajin. Applicants from these Blocks/Municipal
Committees are encouraged to join the initiative.
Apply online through Mission YUVA Portal i.e. http://missionyuva.jk.gov.in > Apply for
SBDU/BHD Expert > Select 'Motivator Empanelment' sheet at the bottom of the page > Select
google form link for Bandipora district to apply.
Deadline- 15 days from the date of Publication of Advertisement
'Conceptual Framework for Motivators' for detailed selection process, role descriptions-
